title: 2nd April - Review
text: Raquel was amazing. She guided us through everything and was very personable! My partner only spoke English and although Raquel said she wasn’t super confident in English, she made every effort to communicate with my partner in English and it came across perfectly! Raquel made our experience unforgettable! - Beth and James
author: betneyp2023

title: The SWEETEST family fun in Barcelona!!!
text:
We had such an amazing experience. Time allowed for making three yummy treats and they were delicious. The menu this month: Cheesecake, Red Velvet Mini Cakes and Apple Biscuit Cookies. 

The staff were all very kind and helpful. 

I highly recommend this experience for families or small groups!
author: D415JOsheilab

title: Fun way to start the day
text: We had a great time. The class was early but we really enjoyed the experience. Raquel was such a lovely teacher and we even learned a bit of Spanish. We ate a couple of our cookies and boxed the rest up to take with us. We live in Barcelona so we may do it again as the sweets change each month. She mentioned something about a monthly card so we will look into that. Great class!
author: therealtiktok
